structured_output.what_is_happening: A 17-minute-old pump.fun copy of "Effective Accelerationism (E/ACC)" launched through rapidlaunch by a serial deployer with 5,275 launches. It rose about 600% to a ~$45k ATH and is now ~$29k, down ~35% from the peak and -16 to -19% over the last 5 minutes. A same-name e/acc token created about 6.3 hours earlier sits at a $17.5M market cap with $320k of hourly volume. This coin is a late copy feeding off that runner.

narrative.description: e/acc (Beff Jezos / effective accelerationism) is a well-known tech-culture meme. It is clearly hot today, since a canonical token already ran to $17.5M. The project's website link points to a beffjezos X post.
narrative.why_spreading: Spillover from the $17.5M same-name runner. Traders are buying cheap copies of the hot ticker, not showing independent interest in this contract.

token_connection.why_this_token: Only the name and ticker match. It launched about 6 hours after the dominant e/acc token and has no canonical link.
token_connection.competing_tokens: CbcyNo7m...AkzpKoU (e/acc, $17.5M mcap, $721k liquidity, the dominant token); GqmEdRD3...Spump (an old 2024 e/acc at $151k)

authenticity.evidence: GMGN tags 109 of 117 holders as bundlers, and the top bundler trader share is 61%. The bot/degen rate is 67%, and there are 5 snipers holding 26% of the top 70. The creator has launched 5,275 tokens and was funded from MEXC. The project X account was renamed from yotsuba_4chan. The coin is flagged as a community takeover and launched through rapidlaunch. On the other side, there are 306 unique buyers in 30 minutes and the top 10 holders own only 23%.
authenticity.uncertainty: GMGN's bundler tags on pump.fun coins can be too broad. Some of the buyers may be real traders rotating in from the main e/acc token.

structural_risks: Serial launcher (5,275 tokens); the creator has already closed or sold out
Holders are almost entirely bundlers, so bundled supply can be dumped into the curve
Copy of a dominant same-name token, so it is capped by the hijack
Momentum is already fading: 35% off the ATH and negative over 5 minutes

structured_output.counterargument: When a meme runs to $17M+, cheap copies sometimes get a second wave as latecomers look for leverage. This coin has real breadth (306 unique buyers), a spread-out top 10, safe mint and freeze settings, and is 76% of the way up the bonding curve. A push to migration could plausibly double it from ~$29k to ~$60k.
unknowns: Whether the main e/acc token keeps pumping and sends more spillover here
How much of the bundled supply has already been sold
Whether any real CTO community exists behind the X link

structured_output.thesis: This is a rapidlaunch copycat of a hot e/acc runner, deployed by a mass launcher and held mostly by bundlers. The first pump has already peaked and is fading. A 2x before a -50% drop needs a fresh spillover wave, which is unlikely. The more likely path is a slow bleed or a dump by insiders.
